name: Zoheth
overview: Zoheth is a male member of the tribe of Judah, identified uniquely as the son of Ishi. His mention in Scripture is brief, with no additional notes or details provided about his life or role beyond his lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Zoheth is a proper name that means 'proud.' This meaning is noted in the Hebrew context and is recorded in 1 Chronicles 4:20. There is no indication that the name was given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Zoheth is the son of Ishi. Beyond this father-son relationship, no other family connections are detailed in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Zoheth's significance in the biblical narrative lies primarily in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Judah, as the son of Ishi. This connection situates him within the broader context of Israel's tribal history, emphasizing the continuity of God's covenant people through Judah's lineage.
